Author: VamprincessDorene
Name: CATS Toybox
Punchline: All of the CATS plugins in one box: Flip Cup, SignSpeak, Cursed Identify, Visor Flash and Move Duplicates.
Description:
One plugin, one window (/toybox), one tab per toy. Turn any toy on or off from the Home tab.

- Flip Cup: play flip cup with friends on a counter in your house (/flipcup).
- SignSpeak: type a message and your character fingerspells it in ASL (/sign).
- Cursed Identify: the cursed smallclothes lock on during /study (needs Glamourer) (/cursed).
- Visor Flash: /visor flashes the Charm Shirt Halter mod (/visorflash).
- Move Duplicates: right-click an item with a retainer or the FC chest open to move duplicate stacks across.
